description.zh: 循环神经网络（RNN）通过循环连接保存历史信息，从而处理序列数据。1986 年，迈克尔·I·乔丹提出把输出状态反馈到上下文单元的乔丹网络；1990 年，杰弗里·埃尔曼展示把隐藏层状态反馈到上下文单元的简单循环网络，两种结构共同奠定了后来语言与序列建模的重要基础。
description.en: Recurrent neural networks process sequences by preserving historical information through recurrent connections. In 1986, Michael I. Jordan proposed the Jordan network, which feeds output state back into context units; in 1990, Jeffrey Elman demonstrated a simple recurrent network that feeds hidden-layer state into context units. Together, these architectures established important foundations for later language and sequence modeling.
